subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled as a hosted Molty deployment/state repair, or is there a remaining OpenClaw source path that can turn Brain & Keys labels into runtime model ids?
rationale: Current source inspection shows the normal UI/gateway path uses canonical ids and persists overrides, but the reporter's hosted evidence shows the deployed path ignores provider/model selection and they cannot inspect or fix hosted state themselves.

options.title: Inspect hosted Molty first
options.body: Check the deployed Brain & Keys payload, stored session/provider override, and outgoing provider request for the affected hosted workspace before queueing a source fix.

options.title: Add source regression if reachable
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this repo path, add a focused UI/gateway regression that prevents label-derived dotted ids and provider-selection drops.

options.title: Route to hosted support/ops
options.body: If usemolty.com owns the failing layer outside this repository, keep this as hosted operations tracking until the deployed service is repaired and verified.

recommendation.title: Inspect hosted Molty first
